_comment: ADR 0264 gamepad + keyboard feel; ADR 0312 (drive-feel-s24): maxLatAccelMs2 4.0 -> 2.5, minAmplitude 0.05 -> 0.02 (a held key / full stick tipped the 40 t high-CoG combination at 30-90 km/h, physics-runner --input-feel), progressive key onset keyOnsetFraction/keyOnsetS. All WORKING_VALUE until the owner's PC feel test, except wheelbaseM (art-source/truck/dims.json wheelbase_m 3.70, WORKING_VALUE there) and maxRoadWheelDeg (tractor_4x2_generic.vehicle.json 40). Same values as the C# defaults in Game.Controls.PadKeyboardFeel. Player adjustments live in input_bindings.json (persistentDataPath).
